text: KPRIET ACADEMIC INFORMATION KPRIET has a Centre for Academic Courses (CFAC). The official academic section provides undergraduate and postgraduate regulations, curriculum and syllabus information. KPR Institute of Engineering and Technology KPR Institute of Engineering and Technology is located at KPR Knowledge Campus, Avinashi Road, Arasur, Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, India. KPRIET is an autonomous institution affiliated to Anna University and approved by AICTE. KPRIET offers undergraduate, postgraduate and MBA programmes. Undergraduate programmes include: Artificial Intelligence and Data Science Biomedical Engineering Chemical Engineering Civil Engineering Computer Science and Engineering Computer Science and Engineering (AI & ML) Computer Science and Engineering (Cyber Security) Computer Science and Business Systems Electrical and Electronics Engineering Electronics and Communication Engineering Electronics Engineering (VLSI Design and Technology) Information Technology Mechanical Engineering Mechatronics

Systems Electrical and Electronics Engineering Electronics and Communication Engineering Electronics Engineering (VLSI Design and Technology) Information Technology Mechanical Engineering Mechatronics Engineering KPRIET describes itself as an AI Integrated Campus and states that Artificial Intelligence is integrated across teaching, learning, research and innovation.
